findings.summary: The standalone Reauthorize regression fixture depends on earlier suite state.
findings.detail: Running test_reauthorize_requires_atomic_intent_success alone reaches the current-head prescription guard before its intended mandatory-S27 assertion because the test does not seed a current bundle; the packet's exact ordered conformance suite and committed evidence pass, and direct review confirms the production guard correctly requires Reauthorize to bind the prescription on the locked current daily head. Make this regression self-contained in a follow-up so focused execution remains durable.
